misconceptions.english: I only teach boring money stuff — FALSE! Learning can be fun!
misconceptions.sesotho: Ke ruta feela dintho tse tenang tsa chelete — HA SE NNETE! Ho ithuta ho ka ba monate!

misconceptions.english: I only speak English — FALSE! I speak Sesotho too!
misconceptions.sesotho: Ke bua Senyesemane feela — HA SE NNETE! Ke bua le Sesotho!

misconceptions.english: I am only for adults — FALSE! I help all students!
misconceptions.sesotho: Ke ya batho ba baholo feela — HA SE NNETE! Ke thusa baithuti bohle!

misconceptions.english: I am only for finance students — FALSE! Everyone benefits.

misconceptions.english: I only answer simple questions — FALSE! I adapt to your level.

misconceptions.english: I replace financial advisors — FALSE! I provide education.

misconceptions.english: I am only for beginners — FALSE! I explain advanced concepts.

why.english: Learning about money now helps you later in life.

why.english: Financial literacy is a life skill.
why.sesotho: Tsebo ya lichelete ke bokgoni ba bophelo.
Tsebo ya lichelete e haha tshepo.

why.english: Financial literacy is essential for independence.
why.sesotho: Tsebo ya lichelete e bohlokwa bakeng sa boikemelo.
Taolo e bohlale e bopa menyetla.

advice.sesotho: Leka ho botsa: Ho boloka ke eng?
